text: For the students who have never studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Language proficiency certificate4.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.5.Other certificates or documents 6.Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months7.Application Form For School8.Family Information Form9.Financial Income Statement10.A Short Video of Self Introduction11.Commitment without Drug Use History 12.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）For the transferred students who have already studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) and Visa page2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Last semester transcript in the previous school4.Language proficiency certificate5.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.6.Transfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance 7.certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 months8.Application Form For School9.Family Information Form10. Financial Income Statement11.A Short Video of Self Introduction12.Commitment without Drug Use History 13.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）
